response.justification: While the candidate has extensive software development experience across multiple languages and domains, there is no evidence of professional C++ development on Windows or direct experience in capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking — the core mandatory requirements for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering background with diverse tech exposure
Demonstrated experience in CI/CD, testing, and dev-ops practices
Active contributor to open-source projects and technical community
concerns: No visible professional C++ or Windows platform experience in resume
Lacks any mention of SQL Server, Oracle, or fixed income domain expertise
Primary stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang — not aligned with C++ capital markets role
